I replied to June in the #strategic-pod thread. The ticket was #8841. Gideon posted on 1 Jul that he closed it with support.

The fix was a browser cache clear on Vantorre's kiosk tablets, done by their IT team. After that, the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing department.

Gideon never posted what the ticket was originally filed as, so I said I couldn't say more than that.
